races.paceDynamic: With all six runners showing hold-up tendencies and no confirmed pace-setters, this small field will likely settle into a pedestrian early gallop. Holly Mist may find herself reluctantly setting the pace from Tiger and Optician, but none will want to make the running on testing ground over this staying trip. The lack of early pace will create a bunched field turning for home, leading to a tactical sprint finish where positioning and a clear run will be crucial. This race shape strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can quicken off a slow pace rather than pure stamers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Tactical Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is pedestrian with Holly Mist reluctantly leading
scenarios.body: The field will be tightly bunched at the two-furlong pole, turning this into a sprint finish where tactical speed and a clear run matter most. Horses who can quicken off the bridle will have a significant advantage over pure stamina types.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Positioning Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Tiger and Optician challenge Holly Mist for the lead entering the back straight
scenarios.body: A genuine pace will develop mid-race, stretching the field and creating a more honest test of stamina on the testing ground. This will suit horses who can stay strongly rather than those relying on a turn of foot.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Breakaway Success
scenarios.trigger: If Holly Mist or Tiger decides to make all from the front
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure will allow the leader to dictate terms and potentially steal a march on the field. Late challengers will struggle to peg back a horse who has conserved energy up front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Stalemate Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If all six horses sit and wait until the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The race will become a pure lottery where the best-positioned horse with the clearest run will prevail regardless of ability. Class and form lines become almost irrelevant in this type of tactical battle.

races.paceDynamic: Rousham and Popty Ping will set a sustainable gallop from the front, with both prominent runners unlikely to create excessive early pressure. The majority field of hold-up horses including Circle Of Trust, Norfolk Blue, and Black Rock Beauty will be happy to settle and wait for the turn-in kick. This creates a moderate pace that should stay even throughout, building to a cavalry charge finish as the field bunches up in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can deliver their finishing kick from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays even and the field comes together turning for home
scenarios.body: The large contingent of closers get ideal racing conditions with plenty to aim at. Circle Of Trust, Black Rock Beauty, and Norfolk Blue can time their challenges perfectly off the sustainable gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Steal It
scenarios.trigger: If Rousham and Popty Ping are allowed too easy a lead through steady fractions
scenarios.body: The pace-setters kick clear before the hold-up brigade can organize their finishing effort. Both have winning form and the soft ground won't inconvenience their stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improved Handicapper Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced improvers finds significant progression from recent runs
scenarios.body: Horses like Surgeon Commander or Forever Twenty, dropping in grade with fresh handicap marks, capitalize on lenient weights. Their hold-up style suits the likely pace scenario perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Rousham and Popty Ping disappoint or are restrained, creating crawling fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the two-furlong pole with no genuine pace. This neutralizes the stamina advantage and creates a lottery finish where any horse can win.

races.paceDynamic: Alpha Capture and Magic Boy will likely set a steady early pace from the front, with Beale Street, Highfield Viking and Wrydcroft tracking prominently. The moderate early tempo will allow the large contingent of hold-up horses including Jenever, Caragio, Tennessee Gold and Green Pursuit to get into contention turning for home. With 13 runners and several prominent racers ensuring no runaway leader, this sets up perfectly for strong finishers to sweep up from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The large group of closers will have plenty to aim at turning in, with the soft ground helping stamina-laden finishers. Jenever, Caragio and Green Pursuit can all unleash strong finishing efforts to overhaul the front-runners.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Magic Boy or Wrydcroft can secure ideal tracking positions behind the leaders
scenarios.body: They avoid the early speed battle while staying close enough to pounce when the pace lifts. Magic Boy's recent winning form and Wrydcroft's progressive profile make them dangerous from this position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Alpha Capture faces minimal early pressure and controls the tempo
scenarios.body: The confirmed front-runner can dictate terms and prove hard to peg back on the testing ground. Alpha Capture's stamina-laden pedigree suggests staying power over this trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the principals fail to fire and a progressive type emerges late
scenarios.body: The handicap nature and large field create upset potential for an improving runner. The Childe Of Hale and Tardaff both have scope for better efforts.

races.paceDynamic: Berry Clever will lead from the gates with minimal early pressure, as the majority of this field prefer to settle off the pace. Commander Of Life, Ziggy's Condor, and Bella Bisbee may track the leader but none are aggressive front-runners, allowing Berry Clever to dictate terms through steady fractions. The race will develop into a sprint finish as the large contingent of hold-up horses including They All Know Me, Follow Your Heart, and Pulsar Star make their moves in the final two furlongs. This sustainable pace scenario clearly favours the prominent racers and patient hold-up horses who can finish strongly, while making life difficult for those needing a strong gallop throughout.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Berry Clever leads uncontested through moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up horses will have perfect conditions to unleash their finishing kicks in the final two furlongs. Class horses like They All Know Me and Follow Your Heart thrive when able to produce one sustained effort.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactics Win
scenarios.trigger: If Berry Clever maintains his lead but gets strong support from Commander Of Life tracking close
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners control the race from the front and kick clear before the hold-up brigade can organize their challenge. Berry Clever's recent course form and De Sousa's tactical nous prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow with multiple horses still in contention at the two-furlong pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where the strongest finishers with recent form dominate. Horses coming from the back of the field find the gaps and superior turn of foot.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Running Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Berry Clever gets an uncontested lead and maintains stamina to the line
scenarios.body: The leader's proven 7f ability on this course allows him to resist all challengers despite the tactical disadvantage. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late on the testing ground.

races.paceDynamic: Yafaarr and Back From Dubai will contest the early lead, with Yafaarr's prominent style likely to see him dictate terms from the front. The lack of confirmed front-runners means Yafaarr can control a steady tempo without significant early pressure. With 16 hold-up horses packed behind, the pace will be measured early before accelerating sharply in the final 2-3 furlongs as the field fans out. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large hold-up contingent.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Yafaarr Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Yafaarr settles into an uncontested lead and dictates a measured pace.
scenarios.body: He can kick clear when the cavalry charge begins, while the packed field behind struggles with traffic and positioning. The prominent runners and any horses that can secure early positions will have a crucial advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Speed Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Back From Dubai or another runner challenges Yafaarr for the early lead.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will suit the stronger stayers among the hold-up horses who can close late. Woodleigh and Sceptic can benefit from the stronger gallop with their proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the large field bunches up turning for home creating a wall of horses.
scenarios.body: Only the horses with clear runs or those already positioned prominently can capitalize. Yafaarr's early position becomes even more valuable while David Allan's experience helps Evelyn's Phoenix find daylight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants the lead early and Yafaarr settles further back than expected.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish favouring the horses with the best turn of foot. Bizarre Law's recent Soft ground win and Silvestre De Sousa's tactical skills come to the fore.

races.paceDynamic: With no confirmed front runners identified, this 15-runner field will likely see several horses reluctantly take it up early before drifting into a sprint finish. The Tunguska Event and Dontwaste A Moment have shown early pace recently and may be pressed forward, but neither wants to make it. Boston Max and Solar Cooper could also find themselves handy if connections are positive. The lack of committed pace-setters creates a messy early tempo that will inevitably quicken dramatically in the final 2f, heavily favouring hold-up horses with a strong turn of foot who can exploit the sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses completely with no one wanting to lead
scenarios.body: The field bunches dangerously approaching the final 2f before exploding into a cavalry charge finish. Hold-up horses with the best turn of foot and racing room prosper in the mayhem.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Early Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If The Tunguska Event or Solar Cooper take up a sensible position early
scenarios.body: A more honest pace develops allowing patient types to still get their run, but those with tactical speed can also capitalize. The race opens up more evenly for different profiles.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Dontwaste A Moment or Boston Max kick clear entering the final furlong
scenarios.body: One horse gets first run and puts the race to bed before the closers can respond. Early positioning and jockey timing become crucial factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wide Open Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make their move simultaneously in the final 2f
scenarios.body: The sprint finish becomes a lottery with little separating the field at the line. Younger horses with less racing experience may struggle in the melee.
